need.name: Managed client IT infrastructure mastership and service graph
need.description: Model a managed IT service provider serving multiple isolated client Dimensions. Describe client-owned infrastructure assets, IT services, dependencies, provider responsibilities, and attribute-level authoritative systems. Separate model specification ownership, data stewardship, owning Dimension, physical storage and master system. Client and provider views are authorized projections rather than competing full copies.
questions: Which client Dimension and master system own each infrastructure fact?
Which provider services depend on which client assets?
How are task updates routed to Jira while infrastructure facts retain their own master system?
